name: Buenos Aires
tagline: Bife de chorizo with a Michelin star, a café haunted by Borges, and the La Boca joint where Francis Mallmann took Anthony Bourdain to eat.

Don Julio.description: The world's most acclaimed steakhouse: a Michelin star, a green star for sustainability, and #1 on Latin America's 50 Best. Critic Pietro Sorba (Clarín) gave it a perfect 5-star rating in 2021.

Café Tortoni.description: Buenos Aires' oldest café, since 1858. Borges, Gardel, and Cortázar all sat at its marble tables.

Don Carlos.description: A family-run joint in La Boca since 1970, with no menu — Carlitos himself decides what you eat. Francis Mallmann brought Anthony Bourdain here as the first stop of his Buenos Aires tour on "Parts Unknown" (2016).

Aramburu.description: A tasting menu of high technical precision from chef Gonzalo Aramburu, in Recoleta. Two Michelin stars.

Crizia.description: An oyster and seasonal fish specialist in Palermo. One Michelin star.
